prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: API 错误码排查对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "错误码" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 49px
  col 2: header "错误信息" · longest unbreakable word 154px · one-line width 154px
  col 3: header "含义" · longest unbreakable word 95px · one-line width 740px
  col 4: header "解决办法" · longest unbreakable word 110px · one-line width 1964px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助开发者根据 API 错误码和错误信息定位原因，并查找对应的解决办法。","reading":"读者通常先扫描错误码或错误信息找到目标行，再横向阅读含义和解决办法；比较多个错误时，需要保持每行的对应关系清晰。","groups":["错误码与错误信息共同标识错误，适合保持紧凑并便于快速扫描。","含义与解决办法共同构成排查内容：前者解释原因，后者指导操作，应获得大部分宽度。"],"keep_intact":["错误码数字","INVALID_APPID、INVALID_CREDENTIAL 等错误信息标识符","AppID、access_token、AppSecret、OpenID 等技术标识符"],"may_wrap":["含义中的中文解释可按自然语义换行。","解决办法中的中文步骤和说明可换行；较长的解决办法通常决定行高，其他列的换行可利用这部分行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [70, 175, 150, 324] · table 720×1244px · row heights [36, 153, 176, 176, 176, 176, 176, 176] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [70, 175, 135, 339] · table 720×1244px · row heights [36, 199, 176, 176, 153, 176, 153, 176] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [70, 175, 116, 358] · table 720×1361px · row heights [36, 222, 176, 199, 176, 199, 176, 176] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"错误码和错误信息完整且易于纵向扫描；含义与解决办法的宽度较平衡，各行高度稳定，横向对应关系清楚。","problems":"含义列仍有较多短行，解决办法列的密集段落需要逐行细读；标识列下方也有较大留白。","cause":"前两列分别为70px和175px，恰好容纳最长标识；含义列150px、解决办法列324px，后者承载大量文字并决定多数行高。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"标识符完整，解决办法比r2A稍宽，部分操作说明的行数减少。","problems":"首行含义出现孤立的“配。”，行高反而明显增加；含义列更碎，部分行的解决办法下方留白增多。","cause":"含义列从150px缩至135px，首行解释因此增至8行；解决办法列增加至339px带来的收益不足以抵消该行的换行。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"解决办法列较宽，长段落较易连续阅读；错误码和错误信息仍保持完整。","problems":"含义列过窄，中文和技术词周围频繁换行，多行由含义而非解决办法决定高度；表格变长，右侧出现更多留白，行内两部分失衡。","cause":"含义列只有116px，总宽扣除内边距和边框后仅剩95px；解决办法列增至358px，挤占了解释所需空间。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-refine","widths":[70,175,158,316],"change":"以r2A为基础，将8px从解决办法移给含义，尝试减少解释中的短行，同时保留足够宽的操作说明。"},{"name":"balanced-nearby","widths":[70,175,145,329],"change":"在r2A与r2B之间试探换行临界点，检查能否增加解决办法宽度，同时避免r2B首行含义的孤立末行。"},{"name":"meaning-priority","widths":[70,175,170,304],"change":"探索更宽的含义列，让原因解释更连贯；利用解决办法原本决定的行高，检验缩窄操作列后整行是否仍保持良好节奏。"}]}
